title: Android / Vulkan Mobile crash on `compute_pipeline_create` on MediaTek / PowerVR GE8320 (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.1.stable (Google Play analytics for Godot Editor app)
- Reproducible in 4.6.stable (Google Play analytics for Godot Editor app)
- Unknown reproducibility in previous versions, but from a quick look I couldn't find `compute_pipeline_create` in 4.5.1.stable crash logs for GE8320 devices.

### System information

Android 14, MediaTek devices with PowerVR GE8320 and GM9446 GPUs

### Issue description

Crash report from the Godot Editor on Google Play after upgrading to 4.6.stable.

So far it's reported specifically against Honor devices (X5b Plus, X6, X6a) but it's only be a few hours, I'll update once there is more data.

*Edit:* Also seen on Oppo A94 with PowerVR GM9446.

Reports for maintainers with access:
https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/5310120689138741555/app/4972363226496209566/vitals/crashes/09fe3cfe4127889deddd0cf9389bc096/details?days=28&isUserPerceived=true
